verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is primarily an immigration law firm, but it also ships Visalaw AI, a SaaS product. A buyer could fairly ask whether that product offers a public API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404, and the product pages describe only chat-style legal workflows and a free trial.
